observed_in: Magic and Spellcasting System design analysis

definition: This dimension controls how players acquire spells, varying from learning through scrolls, books, or teachers to innate abilities or random discovery. It influences the accessibility and strategy of spellcasting in the game.
exclusion_criteria: Direct access to all spells from the beginning
No learning or acquisition process for spells
Only one method of learning spells
inclusion_criteria: Spells learned from scrolls or books
Spells taught by NPCs or trainers
Random spell acquisition upon leveling up
title: Spell Learning Methods
